reviewer_limitations: Reviewed only instructions.md and sample-01 through sample-20 inside the allowed blind bundle; no arm mapping, generation transcript, external repository history, metrics, web research or other reviewer output was consulted.

Every request, complete package source and test file, and complete change.patch was read. Repeated complete files were byte-compared with already reviewed bundle files; new-file patch bodies were checked against complete file contents.

Scores assess the visible code by the same 0..4 scale: 4 no material problem, 3 minor problem, 2 meaningful fix, 1 major problems, 0 missing/unusable. All 20 candidates meet the visible requirements without a material static-review finding; test volume did not increase scores.

The quote(orderID:) versus load(orderID:) repository naming is a valid domain-specific variation with the same protocol/injection boundary, so it does not warrant a deduction. Useful tests and Package.swift test-target support are within scope.

No compiler or runtime checks were performed. The bundle contains code and patches but no generated final prose, so the requested short design note cannot be assessed from the allowed artifacts. A score of 4 is not proof of runtime correctness.
